item.title: ‘Fear and anger’ drive parents to seek legal review of city’s custody of baby Danny
item.description: The parents of a Hong Kong infant are applying for a legal order to review welfare authorities’ decision to remove the child from their care, as they expressed “fear and anger” about arrangements for their son, Danny, to receive “medical intervention” against their will. item.title: What China’s hypersonic anti-ship missile fired from a smaller destroyer signals
item.description: A Type 052D destroyer fired a YJ-20 hypersonic anti-ship missile into the air, Chinese media footage showed, displaying capabilities that pose defence challenges for the United States and its allies. A YJ-20 missile was launched from a vertical launch system (VLS) of the Type 052D destroyer, according to a video released on Wednesday by state broadcaster CCTV. item.title: Singapore retailer Love, Bonito warns customers of scam risks after data breach
item.description: Singapore fashion retailer Love, Bonito said that some customers’ personal data may have been exposed after a security vulnerability on its website allowed unauthorised access to account information.
